scripts.text: A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
Oh? Are you one of our Novice Society?
You seem strong enough to endure the test.
I know a way to become stronger. Are you willing you try it?
If you are satisfied with mediocrity, I can't help you.
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
They're swimmin' away bacause of the noise~
Why are you disrupting my fishing?
I have a delivery from Esseray...
^0000FFA member of Novice Society in Aldebaran.^000000
Hu hu~ my sense is still alive...
So what do you want from me?
Hmm... it is an easy and hard question at the same time.
- You hear a voice complaining about something. -
Esseray! Such a son of a %@&$# spoiling my vacation...
Hey! I can see what you are thinking about in your face~
Since my name is Nodor I've been made fun of my whole life.
Whatever the reason is... you are here!
Let's get together to go further.
- Nodor gives you a suspicious look. -
Didn't you know that the ^0000FFSuper Novice^000000 was excellent?
Do you know who I am?
You've got a lot of nerve, don't you?
So will you believe what I tell you?
Refusing? Don't you want to be strong?
I'd love to do nothing too.
Just let me fish if you want to go.
Hmm, I can't help using such words.
It's no problem for me to teach you to be stronger.
You don't know how to be stronger. Right?
There's a way to do it...
It is dangerous, but I can
I'll only do this on one condition. You do not ask anything and you do everything I tell you!
Are you willing to do this?
To be strong is the only way to live!
Do you want to be a weakling forever?
I will give you a tip.
Sometimes you need to check your ego and listen to others.
Your passion will make you stronger.
What I want you to do is...
Do you know what this is for?
You know what a ^FF0000{0}^000000 monster is, right?
Do not say you can't do this!
I know that's a lot of monsters, but they're so weak!
Don't come back until you've hunted 1,000.
Don't come back until you have.
You are better than I thought.
Anyway, what was the monster that I told you to hunt?
Heheh? Can you seriously hunt Baphomet alone?
Don't tell a lie!! I will hit you!!
I didn't tell you to hunt this!
You annoyed me so I made you do this task...
I guess I can't question your passion to be stronger.
I will let you know how to overcome your strength deficiencies.
Didn't you say you have something to handle?
I got a letter from my brother a long time ago, will you read my letter for your information?
- He throws a bundled letter at you. -
Hey Bro, it's your brother Nudor. How have you been? The reason I'm writing this letter is...
I need money for food. You've got so much money, so help me out.
If you don't... Remember last time you %$&*@*&%$...
- The letter is crumpled, so you can't read more. -
I'm still in the Schwarzwald Republic.
- You get an uneasy feeling from reading this letter. -
Hmm, I only have one brother and he's always asking for money.
It's got to be my fame... T_T
- Now you really have an uneasy feeling. -
You can give some to my bro. He's up in the airship.
How much money should I give?
Oh, you didn't go there yet?
I got another message from my bro.
{0} Zeny is so little considering my celebrity status, don't you think?
Don't you think you gave him too little? My reputation is gonna take a hit now.
Wow, you've got my point already?
This test is about your ability to open someone else's sympathy.
I mean your consuming habit and your gut...
you how to exceed your limit,
Eh-hem! I was not just killing time after I sent you!!
Watch out!! A bunch of Golems are running after us!
- When you are about to doubt... -
You've still got some skill points that aren't used up.
I can't make you stronger until you use those points.
I think our duty and mission as Novices is to make days joyful.
Well then, don't you feel something just changed?
Feel your body lighter than before...?
Eh--- right, you are dull, aren't you?
You can be stronger than before.
Now march to the world and live as a Novice and enjoy your free, happy life!
To celebrate this new Novice comrade, I've prepared some equipment to give you --
Don't forget to make sure that you have enough ^FF0000inventory^000000 to take these items from me.
And don't say I didn't warn you either.
Yes, let me check my inventory.
There are what I used to wear when I was younger,
How can you react like that when I offer you my possessions?
I can't take back what I already gave away.
Now I am going to say greetings again.
Let Super Novice {0} be blessed with the Super Novice Guardian!
Don't forget that you are a Novice.
The aim of life is to have a nice and normal time!
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
- You explain to Nudor why you have come to see him. -
Aha! You've come to give me some pocket money in place of my bro~
Wowowow~~ How much did he give you?
- How much do you want to give? -
Give all the money you have
Lovely~~ Did he give you {0} Zeny? That's pretty much!
Oh... oh my gosh, are you really giving me all the Zeny you have? Really?
Eh? But you don't have any money. You're so poor, huh?
Woa~!! {0} Zeny! This helped me so much~ Tehee~
Did you know? You're really handsome~
I need to tell you, you are really... really~ beautiful.
- tricked, so go back to Nodor. -
I cannot believe that my bro sent me money... I love it~
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
